summary.zh: 按 Material 3 设计原生界面
summary.en: Material Design 3 and Jetpack Compose patterns.

description.zh: 依据 Material Design 3 与 Jetpack Compose 的惯例，规划 Android 原生界面与交互。适合为新应用确定界面方案，或让已有页面贴合 Google 的设计规范。
description.en: Plans native Android interfaces and interactions following Material Design 3 and Jetpack Compose conventions. Fits new app designs or bringing existing screens in line with Google's guidelines.
